title: Don't pay twice
hints: `functools.lru_cache(maxsize=...)` already implements least-recently-used eviction and doesn't cache exceptions. The trick is deciding *what* to cache.

Inside `make_geocoder`, define a small inner function decorated with `@lru_cache(maxsize=maxsize)` that just calls `fetch(key)`. Then return a second function that normalises the address and calls the cached one.
